Iris: quick heads-up - product wants to run an interactive demo tomorrow at 11:00 PT that needs 6xA100 in us-east1 for 90m. current pool shows low headroom. can we confirm availability or give fallback guidance?
Tom: noted. us-east1-demo pool current: capacity=32, used=28, queued=4 (from infra-ci). risk window 10:30-12:00.
cloud-bot: Pool snapshot (us-east1-demo) at 2026-03-21T09:12Z -> free_slots=0 (soft_headroom=-2), maintenance=scheduled 2026-03-21T23:00Z UTC.
Eli: oh, queued jobs likely block it. options: (1) ask infra-ci to defer their smoke run, (2) use fallback pool in us-east4 (8 free) but cross-region latency for demo might show different perf, (3) request vendor preauth for short bump.
Iris: product prefers same-region perf. Tom, can infra-ci move their job to us-east4 for that 90m window?
Tom: CI owners are reachable but that change needs a PR and skip window. faster route is vendor preauth. @vendor-ops can you preauthorize 6xA100 for 2h in us-east1? we'll reconcile charges after.
vendor-ops: we can preauth subject to finance sign-off. submit `/alloc preauth --tenant product-demo --gpu a100 --count 6 --duration 2h --region us-east1 --note "preauth product demo"` and we'll escalate. turnaround ~30m if finance approves.
Iris: doing it now.
Iris: `/alloc preauth --tenant product-demo --gpu a100 --count 6 --duration 2h --region us-east1 --note "preauth product demo"`
cloud-bot: Preauth request created -> ticket INF-5133. state=pending-finance. ETA unknown.
Tom: small fallback plan: prepare a trimmed demo with 3xA100 in us-east4 and mock latency numbers to show expected perf. keep script at `deploy/demo/run.sh` ready. PR #9022 queued for review.
Eli: also propose to add retry+backoff to the demo harness so if alloc is delayed it polls for provisioning for up to 20m instead of immediate fail. small patch incoming.
Iris: thanks. if preauth stalls past 10:40 PT we'll switch to fallback and inform product. please comment in this thread when INF-5133 moves to `preauth-granted` or `denied`.
vendor-ops: finance approved preauth (INF-5133 -> preauth-granted) at 2026-03-21T09:34Z. provisioning ETA ~8m.
cloud-bot: Allocation 8001 queued -> provisioning at 2026-03-21T09:34Z. alloc link: https://redwood.app/alloc/8001
Tom: great. Iris, once provisioned run `rctl lease list --tenant product-demo` and `ssh demo-host-01 -- nvidia-smi` to sanity-check.
Iris: will do. planning to start smoke scenario at 10:50 PT to validate everything. will update when live. :thumbsup:
